name: What is the typical cost to fix slow drains in a whole house?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to fix slow drains in a whole house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to fix slow drains throughout a whole house varies significantly based on the cause and severity of the blockage. Simple main line snaking might be less expensive than issues requiring hydro-jetting, trenchless sewer repair, or tree root removal. During an initial inspection, a plumber will diagnose the problem and provide a transparent estimate tailored to your specific situation. Alpha-Plumbing Services offers clear pricing after a thorough assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost to fix whole-house slow drains varies based on the cause, such as snaking, hydro-jetting, or tree root removal. A plumber provides an estimate after diagnosis.
